retention.title: How long we keep your family’s data
retention.what: {parentPetName}’s words (written transcripts of check-ins and help requests), voice clips and the daily digests are deleted automatically after:
retention.saved: Saved. Older items are deleted after {days, plural, other {# days}}.

canDo.p1: Check in with your parent by voice at times they chose, only about things they agreed to.
canDo.p2: Send you a daily digest that quotes your parent’s own words.
canDo.p3: Alert you when check-ins go unanswered, and show the emergency contact you added.
canDo.p4: Pass on your parent’s non-urgent requests for help to you as a list.
canDo.p5: Play your recorded voice reminders to your parent.

cannotDo.p1: It is not an emergency service and never calls anyone. In an emergency, contact local emergency services.
cannotDo.p2: It is not a medical service. It never diagnoses or gives medical advice.
cannotDo.p3: It cannot ring when the browser is fully closed, and alerts may be late or missed if a phone is off or offline.
cannotDo.p4: It does not track location, use the camera, or listen in the background.
cannotDo.p5: Its companion is an AI voice, not a person, and it never speaks as you.

terms.p1: Your parent’s consent comes first. They choose what is checked and can pause or stop it at any time.
terms.p2: Your parent’s words (written transcripts), short voice clips and the digests are deleted after the period chosen in Settings: 8 days, 15 days or one month. One month is the longest.
terms.p3: Voice recordings are never used to train AI models.
terms.p4: You can delete all of your family’s data at any time in Settings.
terms.p5: We keep a record that you agreed to these terms: the date and time, the terms version and a one-way fingerprint of your internet address (the address itself is not stored). This record is kept even after you delete your data, as proof of consent.
terms.p6: This is a student capstone demo, not a commercial service.

points.p1: You describe your parent’s day. ParCare turns it into a short list of check-ins.
points.p2: You send your parent a one-time link.
points.p3: Your parent opens it, picks their AI companion, and chooses which check-ins they agree to.
points.p4: Nothing is checked until your parent agrees, item by item. They can change or stop it at any time.
points.p5: You get a daily digest in their own words, and an alert if check-ins go unanswered.

points.p4: “You decide what it asks about, and you can switch it off any time.”

pause.title: PAUSE
pause.body: Please contact local help now: someone near you, or your local emergency number.

ringing.title: {name} is asking again
ringing.hint: Please answer so {childName} knows you are all right.

push.title: Notifications

status.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications. Keep the app open to hear alarms.
status.notConfigured: Notifications are not set up on this server yet. Questions still show while the app is open.
status.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings.
status.off: Off. Turn on so your companion's questions reach you when the app is in the background.
status.failed: Could not turn on notifications on this phone. Please try again. If it keeps failing, allow Chrome to show notifications in the phone's settings.

push.limit: A web app cannot ring when the browser is fully closed. Keep it open for the best chance of hearing your companion.
push.nudge: Notifications are off on this phone, so you only see my questions when you open ParCare. Turn them on to be told when I ask.

reminder.title: A voice reminder from {childName}
reminder.playing: Playing {childName}'s message. It repeats until you tap OK.
reminder.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete this message?
delete.everyoneNote: “Delete for everyone” also removes it from {childName}'s app and any evening summary. “Delete for me” hides it only here.
delete.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

parentSetup.title: Your ParCare
parentSetup.later: We can finish this later. Everything so far is saved; just open ParCare again.
parentSetup.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

companion.title: Choose your companion
companion.intro: Your companion will check in with you. Whichever you choose is an AI voice, not a person. You can change it any time.

day.title: Your day
day.question: {firstName}, can you tell me about your day, from when you wake up to when you go to sleep?
day.hint: Tap the mic and speak, then tap it again. Or type. Say it in your own words.
day.label: Your day
day.empty: Please tell me a little about your day first.
day.skip: Skip this. I will add my check-ins myself

followups.title: A few questions
followups.intro: {childName} mentioned a few things you did not. Only answer what is true for you.
followups.question: {childName} said you have “{label}”{time, select, none {} other { around {time}}}. Shall I check in with you about it?

checklist.title: Your check-ins
checklist.say: Here is what I understood. For each one, tell me if I may check in with you, and at what time. I do not want to micromanage you. I want to make sure you are healthy and happy.
checklist.intro: Tick only what you want. Change any time from the list. You can pause, change or stop any of them later in Settings.
checklist.yes: Yes, check in with me about this
checklist.none: You have not chosen any check-ins. That is fine: nothing will be checked.
checklist.notChecked: {n, plural, one {# more item is not checked} other {# more items are not checked}}. You can turn it on later in Settings.
checklist.empty: Your list is empty. Add the check-ins you want below.

thanks.title: Thank you
thanks.note: I am happy to be in touch with you. Your kids want to be a bigger part of your day even though they live away.
thanks.summary: Send {childName} a short summary each evening of the check-ins I share
thanks.summaryHint: Only the check-ins you marked “Share” are included, in your own words.

alarms.title: If you do not answer
alarms.explain: First I remind you. If you do not answer, I remind you again after {a} minutes with an alarm sound. If you still do not answer, I tell {childName} after {b} more minutes: “I checked in twice and did not hear back.” I never call anyone.
alarms.notify: Turn on notifications so my questions reach your phone even when ParCare is not open. The alarm sound plays when you open the app; when it is closed, your phone shows a notification with its own sound.

terms.title: What ParCare can and cannot do
terms.accept: I have read this and agree
terms.required: Please tick the box to finish.

add.title: Add a check-in
add.hint: Anything I missed, or anything new. You can change or pause it later.
add.what: What should I check in about?
add.bad: Please write what to check in about (up to 80 letters) and pick a time from the list.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email you log in with. We will email you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentTo: If an account exists for {email}, we have emailed it a link to reset the password. It works once, for 1 hour. Check your spam folder too.
forgot.sameBrowser: Open the link on this phone, in this browser.
forgot.demoLink: Demo mode: no email is sent. Use this link instead:
forgot.resent: A new link is on its way. Only the newest link works.

forgotErrors.tooSoon: A link was sent a moment ago. Please wait a minute before asking again.
forgotErrors.demoAccount: This is a shared demo account, so its password cannot be changed.
forgotErrors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.expired: This reset link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.

resetPasswordErrors.weakPassword: Please use at least 8 characters for the new password.
resetPasswordErrors.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
resetPasswordErrors.samePassword: Please choose a password different from your old one.
resetPasswordErrors.linkExpired: This reset link has expired. Please ask for a new one.
resetPasswordErrors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

replies.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
replies.audio: That recording did not work. Please record again (up to 60 seconds).
